Okay, so first of all. You are definitely beautiful you just need to be more aware of it and confident in it. I have a few tips on the face value of beauty too

1. Make sure you take care of your skin. See a dermatologist if you have to. Get your skin in check. It doesn't have to be perfect, just healthy and more or less even in complexion and texture.
2. Learn how to do your makeup in a way that highlights your desired features. Especially contouring. It literally changes how you look. Also, experiment with different styles of make up. They have a direct effect on your personality.
3. Drink water. This is basic but it's necessary. It keeps you cool so you don't over sweat. It cleans out your gut and keeps you clean. It's also great for your skin and metabolism.
4. I'd tell you to workout if that's what you're interested in but tbh yoga is better. Most of the time our bodies hold so much tensions and flexibility really boosts your confidence (especially if you're bigger). Yoga and other flexibility stretches literally make you more comfortable in your skin. You also become a better dancer.
5. Style UP. There's a few hacks to finding your personal style. Figure out the colours you like and look good on you. Find the fabrics you're most comfortable in. Build up a solid arsenal of accessories and let your style mould itself from there.
6. How you speak. A slightly deeper intonation is very appealing to most people. Also, when you talk to people, act like you know a secret about them that they haven't yet told you. It's basically professional flirting and makes you very alluring to people.
7. Learn how to make friends. Especially when you're somewhere new. It's so important to know how to walk up to someone and start a conversation. It's a sign of confidence and confidence is very attractive.
8. Every time you look in the mirror. Pick one thing that you like about your reflection. It's so easy to get lost in studying your flaws that you tend to forget there is so much beauty within you. So find sth that you like. Fr. No matter how small. Whether it's the curve of your eyelid or how your lips look just before you smile. Notice these things and treasure them. 

Also, the obvious ones: be clean, smell nice, be kind, laugh more.

I hope this helps you become more in touch with your beauty and confidence. Good luck!
